title: 第388章 陛下，求求你不要死
slug: 九恶妃每日一问陛下驾崩了吗
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“融为一体吗？”

香香原本甜腻的笑容中，忽然多出了一抹讥讽。

秦然瞳孔一缩，“爱妃，你…怎么了？”

他硬挤出一抹笑容，“你入秘境之前，我们不是已经说好了，今夜便合二为一，你现在想要反悔？”

香香脸上笑容瞬间消失殆尽。

转而化为彻骨冰寒。

“这些话是本宫和他说的！”

“而你…不是他！！”

秦然怔住了，脸上露出了深深的不可置信。

“你！你一直都是清醒的？”

香香冷冷一笑，“本宫刚醒。”

“那你是如何发现不对劲的！”秦然的声音阴沉的吓人。

“本宫刚说过了，你…不是他！”

“不可能！”秦然的面目陡然狰狞，“既然你发现了，为何刚才还要配合！”

香香笑容莫名，“你顶的这张脸，值得姑奶奶陪你演一会儿，现在表演结束，你可以散了～”

嗡！！！

香香身后的空气中，那尊与秦然有十成相似的灵魂法相凝聚而出。

金光一荡，眼前的秦然瞬间散成了点点黑雾……

噗！！！

秘境深处，黑影在重重迷雾之中重新凝聚，黑色灵魂之力再次削减了大半，已只剩下不多的一缕。

“妖孽！！”

“区区大天尊境，竟能连续防备下本帝的灵魂幻境！！”

黑色灵魂之力剧烈波动，语气中充斥着愤怒和不甘。

“本帝已苦等了五万年！”

“如此好皮囊，为何不能夺舍！！！”

“毁了本帝七成灵魂之力，此九尾天狐血脉，就算不能夺舍，也定要将其吞噬殆尽！！”

灵魂之力狰狞暴躁，小世界内，雾气剧烈涌动。

过了许久，她才缓缓平息下来。

“灵魂之力已所剩不多，既然九尾天狐无法夺舍…那只能选择她了。”

黑色灵魂之力的视线，转向了第八层上的小灵儿。

“八尾血脉差了一些，但没有其他选择了。”

“八尾灵狐和帝狐族，同有一丝狐类血统，灵兽虽然与神魔族无法完美融合，但只要花费些时间，估计也能达到巅峰期的八成以上。”

“只能如此了。”

第八层玉台上。

小灵儿正苦苦坚持着，口中喃喃自语。

“香香姐姐，你一定要成功，一定要拿下帝术！”

“这样，我们就能好好帮他了。”

Page (1/3)

"Integrate into one?"

There was suddenly a touch of sarcasm in Xiangxiang's originally sweet smile.

Qin Ran's pupils shrank, "My dear concubine, what's wrong with you?"

He forced a smile and said, "Before you entered the secret realm, didn't we already agree that we would become one tonight, and now you want to go back on it?"

The smile on Xiangxiang's face disappeared instantly.

It turned into bone-chilling coldness.

"These words were spoken to him by me!"

"And you... are not him!!"

Qin Ran was stunned, with deep disbelief on his face.

"You! Are you always awake?"

Xiangxiang smiled coldly, "I just woke up."

"Then how did you find out something was wrong!" Qin Ran's voice was gloomy and scary.

"I just said, you... are not him!"

"Impossible!" Qin Ran's face suddenly turned ferocious, "Since you discovered it, why did you still cooperate just now?"

Xiangxiang smiled inexplicably, "The face you put on is worthy of my aunt acting with you for a while. Now that the performance is over, you can go away~"

Buzz!!!

In the air behind Xiangxiang, the soul figure that was 100% similar to Qin Ran condensed out.

As soon as the golden light swayed, Qin Ran in front of him instantly dispersed into black mist...

Poof!!!

Deep in the secret realm, the black shadows regrouped in the fog, and the power of the black soul was again reduced by half, leaving only a few strands.

"Monster!!"

"A mere Great Heavenly Lord can actually continuously guard against the illusion of my soul!!"

The power of the black soul fluctuated violently, and his tone was full of anger and unwillingness.

"This emperor has been waiting for fifty thousand years!"

"Why can't you take away the body if you have such a good body!!!"

"Having destroyed 70% of the power of my soul, this nine-tailed fox bloodline, even if I can't take away my body, I will definitely devour it all!!"

The power of the soul is ferocious and violent, and the mist surges violently in the small world.

After a long time, she slowly calmed down.

"There is not much soul power left. Since the nine-tailed sky fox cannot take over...then we can only choose her."

The sight of the black soul power turned to Little Ling'er on the eighth floor.

"The eight-tailed bloodline is a little worse, but there is no other choice."

"The eight-tailed spirit fox and the emperor fox tribe share a trace of fox blood. Although the spirit beast cannot perfectly integrate with the gods and demons, as long as it takes some time, it is estimated that it can reach more than 80% of its peak."

"That's all."

On the jade platform on the eighth floor.

Little Ling'er was struggling to hold on, mumbling to herself.

"Sister Xiangxiang, you must succeed, you must win the imperial technique!"

"In this way, we can help him properly."
